q: The Margulis-Ruelle inequality states that for a C¹ diffeomorphism T of a compact Riemannian manifold with invariant measure μ:
opts: h_μ(T) ≤ Σᵢ max(λᵢ,0) (sum of positive Lyapunov exponents, integrated over μ)
h_μ(T) = 0 if all Lyapunov exponents are negative
exp: Margulis-Ruelle inequality: h_μ(T) ≤ ∫ Σᵢ max(λᵢ(x),0) dμ(x). Equality characterises SRB measures (Pesin's formula). The inequality is proven by bounding the growth of volumes under T via Lyapunov exponents, using the Oseledets theorem.
